The '''Circarpous system''', also known as the '''Circarpous Major system''', or as the '''Mimban system''', contained fourteen [[Planet/Legends|planets]].

While many of the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] inhabitants were sympathetic to the cause of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], they were afraid to become involved and risk the wrath of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

The planet [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], also known as Circarpous V, was located in this system. The system was centered around [[Circarpous Major]].

The Circarpous system was invaded and occupied by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Their [[Fire Breather]]s obtained [[swamp gas]] from Mimban for use in the [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] invasion.
